versions.name: Camp Lakota

features.note: Basketry, leatherwork, pottery, and wood carving in the STEAM area.
The health lodge doubles as the first aid and emergency preparedness program area.
An ecology area covering environmental science, geology, weather, and nature.
Outbounds take units out of the main camp overnight, including En-Sa-Wac-Sa, a canoe trek of four to eight miles on the Auglaize and Maumee rivers.
Stand Up Paddle Board award at the boat docks.
Small-boat sailing at the boat docks.
The STEAM area combines STEM badges with handicraft and performance.
A learn-to-swim progression alongside swimming and lifesaving instruction.
The 48-acre Lake Glengary, with a beach and boat docks; program areas sit around the lake.
Welding is taught as a block badge in the STEAM area.

versions.summary: Black Swamp Area Council's 640-acre Scouts BSA resident summer camp situated on Lake Glengary in Defiance, Ohio.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
